brave_rewards.note: Connect Brave Rewards to Phantom: brave://rewards → Connect → Phantom

setup_guide.step_1: Open Phantom on desktop → copy your Solana address
setup_guide.step_3: Open Brave → brave://rewards → Connect account → Phantom
setup_guide.step_4: BAT earnings now flow to your Phantom wallet on Solana
setup_guide.step_5: Import phone wallet seed into desktop Phantom → send all tokens to primary
setup_guide.step_6: SolarPunk monitors everything automatically each cycle
